title.en: Meaning and objectives of a trial balance

hook.en: A shop owner posts hundreds of entries in a year. How can the accountant quickly check that every debit has an equal credit? With a trial balance.
hook.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಅಂಗಡಿ ಮಾಲೀಕ ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ನೂರಾರು ನಮೂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಖತಾವಣಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಡೆಬಿಟ್‌ಗೆ ಸಮಾನ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಇದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಬೇಗ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ.

objectives.en: State the objectives of preparing a trial balance.
Classify ledger balances as debit or credit.

narration.en: A shop owner posts hundreds of entries in a year. How can the accountant quickly check that every debit has an equal credit? With a trial balance.
narration.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಅಂಗಡಿ ಮಾಲೀಕ ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ನೂರಾರು ನಮೂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಖತಾವಣಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಡೆಬಿಟ್‌ಗೆ ಸಮಾನ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಇದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಬೇಗ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ.

body.en: A trial balance is a statement of the debit and credit balances of all ledger accounts, including cash and bank, prepared on a particular date. It is a statement, not an account. Because of the double entry system, the total of the debit balances must equal the total of the credit balances.

points.en: Prepared on a particular date, usually the end of the year
It is a statement, not an account

narration.en: A trial balance is a statement of the debit and credit balances of all ledger accounts, including cash and bank, prepared on a particular date. It is a statement, not an account. Because of the double entry system, the total of the debit balances must equal the total of the credit balances.
narration.kn: ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಒಂದು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ದಿನಾಂಕದಂದು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಖಾತೆಗಳ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಬಾಕಿಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿ. ಇದು ಖಾತೆಯಲ್ಲ, ಒಂದು ಪಟ್ಟಿ. ದ್ವಿನಮೂದು ಪದ್ಧತಿಯಿಂದಾಗಿ ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿಯ ಮೊತ್ತಗಳು ಸಮವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು.

blocks.formula: \text{Total of debit balances} = \text{Total of credit balances}

title.en: On the board: A trial balance in one picture

say.en: A trial balance lists every ledger balance on one date: debit balances in one column, credit balances in the other.
Assets and expenses have debit balances.
Capital, income and liabilities have credit balances.
Both columns total 78,000. The trial balance agrees.
It checks arithmetical accuracy, helps locate errors, summarises the ledger and is the base for the final accounts.

body.en: A trial balance helps to (1) check the arithmetical accuracy of ledger posting, (2) locate errors, (3) give a summary of the ledger accounts in one place, and (4) serve as the base for preparing the financial statements.

narration.en: A trial balance helps to (1) check the arithmetical accuracy of ledger posting, (2) locate errors, (3) give a summary of the ledger accounts in one place, and (4) serve as the base for preparing the financial statements.
narration.kn: ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು: ಖತಾವಣಿಯ ಅಂಕಗಣಿತದ ನಿಖರತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು, ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ಪತ್ತೆ ಹಚ್ಚುವುದು, ಖಾತೆಗಳ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ನೀಡುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳ ತಯಾರಿಕೆಗೆ ಆಧಾರವಾಗುವುದು.

caption.en: A one-sided error (the sales book undercast) makes the columns disagree; a two-sided error (a credit sale omitted completely) does not.

narration.en: Move the sliders to put an error into the books and watch the two columns.

tryThis.en: Set an omission of ₹4,000. Do the totals still agree? Is the ledger correct?
Undercast the sales book by ₹500. Which column is short?
Why is agreement not conclusive proof of accuracy?

problem.en: Arrange these balances of Vinayaka Stores in a trial balance and check that it agrees: Cash ₹15,000; Machinery ₹40,000; Purchases ₹20,000; Rent ₹3,000; Capital ₹50,000; Sales ₹20,000; Creditors ₹8,000.

steps.en: Debit balances (assets, expenses): Cash 15,000 + Machinery 40,000 + Purchases 20,000 + Rent 3,000 = ₹78,000.
Credit balances (capital, income, liabilities): Capital 50,000 + Sales 20,000 + Creditors 8,000 = ₹78,000.
Debit total ₹78,000 = Credit total ₹78,000, so the trial balance agrees.

answer.en: Both sides total ₹78,000; the trial balance agrees.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Arrange these balances of Vinayaka Stores in a trial balance and check that it agrees: Cash ₹15,000; Machinery ₹40,000; Purchases ₹20,000; Rent ₹3,000; Capital ₹50,000; Sales ₹20,000; Creditors ₹8,000.

heading.en: DEAD CLIC: which side does a balance go?

body.en: Debit side: Drawings, Expenses, Assets. Credit side: Liabilities, Income, Capital. Losses go with expenses; gains go with income.

narration.en: DEAD CLIC: which side does a balance go?. Debit side: Drawings, Expenses, Assets. Credit side: Liabilities, Income, Capital. Losses go with expenses; gains go with income.

mnemonic.en: DEAD = Debits: Expenses, Assets, Drawings  |  CLIC = Credits: Liabilities, Income, Capital

narration.en: Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: A trial balance is a statement of ledger balances on a given date.
points.kn: ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿ ಎಂದರೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ದಿನಾಂಕದ ಖಾತೆ ಬಾಕಿಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿ.

points.en: Assets, expenses, losses and drawings have debit balances.
points.kn: ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳು, ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು, ನಷ್ಟಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಂತ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಬಾಕಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Capital, liabilities, incomes and gains have credit balances.
points.kn: ಬಂಡವಾಳ, ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಗಳು, ಆದಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಲಾಭಗಳಿಗೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಬಾಕಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: It checks arithmetical accuracy and is the base for final accounts.
points.kn: ಇದು ಅಂಕಗಣಿತದ ನಿಖರತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಿಮ ಖಾತೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಧಾರ.

homework.en: State whether each has a debit or credit balance: Bills receivable, Bank overdraft, Commission received, Carriage inwards, Drawings.

narration.en: Recap. A trial balance is a statement of ledger balances on a given date. Assets, expenses, losses and drawings have debit balances. Capital, liabilities, incomes and gains have credit balances. It checks arithmetical accuracy and is the base for final accounts.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿ ಎಂದರೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ದಿನಾಂಕದ ಖಾತೆ ಬಾಕಿಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿ. ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳು, ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು, ನಷ್ಟಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಂತ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಬಾಕಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಂಡವಾಳ, ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಗಳು, ಆದಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಲಾಭಗಳಿಗೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಬಾಕಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಅಂಕಗಣಿತದ ನಿಖರತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಿಮ ಖಾತೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಧಾರ.
